20 | Ignore Vacuum | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U

30 | Water Dwelling True | caster | 1 hr/lvl | self | U
50 | Changing Environment | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster may make a Situational Awareness (Combat) maneuver with a special
modification of +25. This maneuver is granted by this spell and requires no
separate action to be declared.
@@ 2
Caster can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight.
@@ 3
Caster has a 300 degree field of vision. The flank bonus for attacks against
the caster is lowered to +5 and the rear bonus is lowered to +15.
@@ 4
As Nightvision, except the caster can see 100' in even murky water.
@@ 5
As BattleAwareness, except bonus to the maneuver is +50.
@@ 6
Caster can breathe water but not air.
@@ 7
Target can swim without expending energy (i.e., will expend no exhaustion
points).
@@ 8
As Nightvision, except the caster can see 100' in smoke, fog, rain, or any gas
that would normally impede vision.
@@ 9
As Waterlungs, except the caster can breathe any gas as normal air.
@@ 10
As Nightvision, except that any darkness can be seen through. Also, no light
is needed for this spell to work.
@@ 11
Delays the effect of a poison on the caster. If poison is not eliminated
before the spell expires, the caster will be affected by the poison at that
time.
@@ 12
As Swimming, except the caster can also perform any maneuvers (including melee
combat) as though he were on dry land.
@@ 13
As Waterlungs, except caster can breathe water, air, and or any gas at will.
@@ 14
Caster can ignore the effects of high pressures such as those found deep under
water.
@@ 15
Caster and his equipment are immune to the effects of normal (non-magical)
fire for the duration. He may perform any movement or maneuvers as normal.
@@ 17
Combines the effects of Watervision, Waterlungs, and Water Maneuvering.
@@ 18
Caster does not need to breathe to survive for the duration.
@@ 19
Combines the effects of Gasvision, Gaslungs, and Fire Maneuvering.
@@ 20
Caster and his equipment are immune to the effects of airless environments for
the duration. This spell gives the caster a +50 RR versus vacuum attacks. Note
that this spell does not confer any protection against the heat or cold of the
vacuum of space.
@@ 25
Caster and his equipment can ignore the effects of any natural (non-magical)
temperatures.
@@ 30
As Water Dwelling except for duration.
@@ 50
Caster can survive comfortably and move and maneuver as normal in any of the
hostile environments the lower level spells on this list protect against.
